_method: COCO person detector (fasterrcnn_mobilenet_v3_large_fpn), all people above score 0.5; walkway contact = any green pixel (G - max(R,B) > 15) in a 9x9 window at the bottom-centre of the person's box.
_not_a_safety_judgement: Standing on green paint is not working safely, and a frame with no detection is not an empty frame. This is caption evidence, not a verdict.
